neighbours.label: The second member of a coordinated pair of complementary counterparts (western and eastern, yes and no, niece and nephew, heat and cool, locked and unlocked, Friday and Saturday); 'and' joining unrelated items does not carry it
fire: The clinic has separate entrances for the upper and lower floors.
Her aunt and uncle drove up from Cornwall for the wedding.
The thermostat can heat and cool the room within minutes.
Classes run on Tuesday and Wednesday evenings during term.
The jury must weigh the positive and negative effects of the merger.
He locked and unlocked the door several times to test the key.
The survey asked for both the strengths and weaknesses of the course.
Sort the samples into the wet and dry categories before weighing.
quiet: The clinic has separate entrances for the upper floors and the car park.
Her aunt and a neighbour drove up from Cornwall for the wedding.
The thermostat can heat the room and log the temperature.
Classes run on Tuesday and attendance is recorded during term.
The jury must weigh the positive effects and the legal costs of the merger.
He locked the door and tested the key several times.
The survey asked for the strengths and the overall rating of the course.
Sort the samples into the wet category and label the jars before weighing.
